issues.legal_issue: A co-sharer retains a share in agricultural land deemed settled with another co-sharer in actual possession when that possession is not adverse, allowing the partition suit to proceed.
material_facts: A partition suit concerned bakasht agricultural lands, and a preliminary decree had declared the plaintiff’s share.

After land-reform legislation came into force, the appellants sought to stop the final-decree proceedings, asserting that the lands had vested in the State and been settled with those in actual khas possession.
The appellants were in actual khas possession, but did not claim to be trespassers or to hold title adverse to the plaintiff, who was their co-sharer.
issues.conclusion: The plaintiff had not lost his share in the bakasht lands and retained a right to that share as a raiyat; the partition suit could proceed. The appeal was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Under sections 2(k) and 6 of the Bihar Land Reforms Act, 1950, the statutory deeming of settlement with a person in khas possession benefits those regarded in law as in actual possession. A co-sharer is in constructive possession through another co-sharer because possession by one co-sharer is possession by all, unless the possession is adverse or otherwise independent of the claimant’s title. The Court followed P. L. Reddy v. L. L. Reddy, [1957] S.C.R. 195, 202. It distinguished Surajnath Ahir v. Prithinath Singh, [1963] 3 S.C.R. 290, Ram Ran Bijai Singh v. Behari Singh, [1964] 3 S.C.R. 363, and S. P. Shah v. B. N. Singh, [1969] 3 S.C.R. 908, and referred to the Full Bench decision in Mahant Sukhdeo Das v. Kashi Prasad Tewari.

rule.if: proceeding_is_partition_suit and land_reform_vesting_has_occurred and agricultural_land_in_actual_possession_of_coshare and claimant_is_coshare and possession_is_not_adverse

predicates.proceeding_is_partition_suit: The proceeding seeks partition of land among co-sharers.
predicates.land_reform_vesting_has_occurred: A land-reform measure has vested former estate interests in the State.
predicates.agricultural_land_in_actual_possession_o: Agricultural land is in the actual possession of one co-sharer.
predicates.claimant_is_coshare: The person asserting a share in the land is a co-sharer of the person in actual possession.
predicates.possession_is_not_adverse: The co-sharer in actual possession does not claim the land adversely to the claimant or as a trespasser.
predicates.claimant_retains_share_as_raiyat_and_par: The claimant retains a share in the land as a raiyat and the partition suit may proceed.

issues.definition: When a partition suit concerns agricultural land vested under land-reform measures, one co-sharer’s actual possession is not adverse, and another co-sharer claims a share, the claimant retains that share as a raiyat and partition may proceed.
